culture.text: Part of gategroup, whose 27,000 employees serve over 250 airlines in more than 30 countries; gategourmet itself lists about 11,016 staff.
Daily work is hands-on: preparing tens of thousands of passenger meals and handling more than 2 million flights a year.
Staff come from many countries and typically studied business, logistics and supply chain, HR or accounting.
